agenda_text:
Regular Planning Commission Meeting
REGULAR PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday MARCH 11, 2021
07:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
7:00 p.m.
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER
2. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE TO THE FLAG
3. ROLL CALL: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair Avery
Commissioner Fraga-Saenz, Henderson, and Smith
4. REVIEW OF AGENDA
5. MOTION TO WAIVE FULL READING OF ALL RESOLUTIONS ON THE AGENDA FOR THIS MEETING
6. PUBLIC COMMENTS ON CONSENT CALENDAR ITEMS AND ANY ITEMS NOT ON THE AGENDA
7. CONSENT CALENDAR
7A. Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of February 11, 2021
7A
8. PUBLIC HEARINGS
8A. Zoning Ordinance Amendment 21-001
City of Palmdale, Applicant
(Continued from February 11, 2021)
A request to amend Title 17 of the Palmdale Municipal Code to allow short-term rentals within the R-1, R-2, R-3, R-4, and MX zones.
Staff Recommendation: Staff is recommending that Zoning Ordinance Amendment 21-001 be continued in order to allow staff additional time to finalize the draft regulations and procedures. Drew Pletcher, Deputy Director of Economic and Community Development
8A
8B. Tentative Tract Map 81337
Royal Investors Group, LLC, Applicant
(Continued from February 11, 2021)
A request to subdivide one parcel totaling approximately 40 acres into 86 single-family residential lots located between 65th Street West and 70th Street West approximately 650 feet south of West Avenue M. (APN: 3204-025-048).
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2021-007 approving Tentative Tract Map 81337 and adopt the Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation Monitoring Reporting Program, finding that the project will not result in a significant impact on the environment. Justin Sauder, Associate Planner
8B
8B Exhibit VI
8C. Zoning Ordinance Amendment 21-002
City of Palmdale, Applicant
A request to amend Sections 17.16 (Definitions), 17.26.040 (Minor Modifications to Approved Plans, 17.95.040 (Communication Facilities), 17.95.05 (Wireless Telecommunication Facilities in the Public Right-of-Way) and to add Section 17.95.060 (Emergency Standby Generators) of Palmdale Municipal Code Title 17 Zoning to update the standards for the permitting, development, siting, installation, aesthetics, design, operation and maintenance of wireless telecommunication facilities and to provide for the installation of Emergency Standby Generators in compliance with State and Federal requirements.
Staff Recommendation: Staff is recommending that Zoning Ordinance Amendment 21-002 be continued to allow staff additional time to finalize the draft regulations and procedures. Benjamin Fiss, Senior Planner
8C
9. PRESENTATION General Plan Update – Preferred Land Use Alternative
Megan Taggart, Planning Manager
9
9 Attachments
10. STAFF COMMUNICATIONS
Megan Taggart, Planning Manager
11. PLANNING COMMISSION COMMUNICATIONS
12. ADJOURNMENT TO THE REGULAR PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING OF THURSDAY, APRIL 8, 2021, AT 7:00 P.M. Regular Planning Commission Agenda
March 11, 2021
Page 3
